reason: I already have my gummies that I reorder when they run out, and a drawer full of half-used bottles I feel guilty about. Two capsules a day is exactly what I stop doing after a week, so I'm not adding another one.
objection: I'd just be buying one more thing I quit taking by week two. Two capsules to swallow every day is not for me, and I don't know why this is better than what I already take.
would_change_my_mind: A real person I follow showing it works for sleep in a week or two, plus a price low enough that wasting a box doesn't sting, like a $9.99 trial box.
